'''Virne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served in the military of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

In [[3643 BBY]] he and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Ascercia]] were stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and were sent on a mission to install a prototype Imperial sensor array, only their party was attacked by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] and the Imperials that carried the sensors were killed and cocooned to the hive. They tasked a fellow Imperial to recover and install the sensors. Their commanding officer was [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pharoth]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=general|Bugs and Bombs|Alderaan}}</ref>
